name: Omnitsu: Slash or Die
detailed_description:
Omnitsu is a time survival game that combines minimalist mechanics with roguelike elements. When the gates of hell burst open and monstrous hordes overrun the world, only your mastery of evolving abilities can keep you standing. How long can you endure the relentless onslaught?

Will you rise to the challenge - or be swallowed by darkness?

Key Features

1. Fluid Mobility

  • Swift Dodges & Dashes: Outmaneuver enemies with quick sidesteps, slides, and aerial acrobatics.

  • Active Powers: Unleash devastating energy blasts, crowd-control fields, or supportive auras that enhance your movement.

  • Master Your Movement: The faster you learn to move, the longer you’ll survive the onslaught.

2. Ever-Changing Dungeons

  • Procedurally Generated Floors: Each run presents new layouts, traps, and secrets, ensuring no two expeditions are the same.

  • Dynamic Challenges: Adapt your strategy as dungeons shift and monsters become more unpredictable.

  • Hidden Treasures: Seek out secret rooms packed with powerful relics, rare loot, and fragments of lore.

3. Evolving Arsenal of Weapons

  • Varied Weapon Types: Wield everything from swift swords and heavy hammers to arcane staves and quick moving shurikens.

  • Upgrade & Customize: Each new run gives you the chance to customize a new loadout, as well as find secret items.

  • Synergistic Builds: Experiment with different loadouts to discover synergies.

4. Epic Boss Fights

  • Colossal Foes: Battle massive demons that demand tactical prowess and lightning-fast reflexes.

  • Unique Mechanics: Dodge bullet-hell projectiles, exploit enemy weaknesses, and adapt to ever-changing attack patterns.

  • Rewarding Victories: Triumph over bosses to earn rare weapons and abilities that permanently boost your hero.

Wishlist Now & Prepare for Battle!
